Game Overview

At its heart, Slime Escape is a puzzle game about guide a wobbly Slime through intricate mazes filled with twists and tight passageways. Strategically maneuver to uncover escape keys, unlocking a path to freedom. Each maze offers fresh puzzles that demand keen observation and clever planning. Can you master the art of slime navigation and escape?
